purpose_text.para: Captures the Timestamp value on a BRBE freeze event.

field_description.para: Timestamp value at the time of a BRBE freeze event.

field_reset_special_text.para: When FEAT_BRBEv1p1 is implemented, Arm recommends that this field is preserved on a Warm reset, but it is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether this field resets to 0 or is preserved.
When FEAT_BRBEv1p1 is implemented, on a Cold reset it is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether this field resets to an architecturally UNKNOWN value.
